minor.issue: ElevenLabs returns 404 voice_not_found for voice_id '21m00Tcm4Tlm7axTlAzs' (Rachel). The voice has been removed/rotated by ElevenLabs. Sandberg persona TTS is permanently broken until VOICE_REGISTRY['sandberg'].voice_id is updated to a currently-available library voice.

/challengers page fires multiple parallel TTS requests on mount → ElevenLabs plan has concurrent_limit=3 → requests 4+ fail with 429 concurrent_limit_exceeded → backend wraps as 502. Suggestion: either serialize the challenger card TTS requests (queue with max 3 concurrent), lazy-load only on hover/click, or catch 429 in routes/voice_tts.py L241 and return graceful 200 with audio_url='' like the conversation endpoint already does.

integration_issues.issue: 5x /api/voice/tts return 502 on page load (root cause: ElevenLabs 429 concurrent_limit + sandberg voice_id 404). User experience degrades gracefully (no audio), but browser console shows 502 errors.

issues: React warning: 'Can\'t perform a React state update on a component that hasn\'t mounted yet' — indicates a useEffect without a mounted-guard/cleanup somewhere in DownloadsPage.js or a child. Non-blocking but should be cleaned up.
React 18 warning: 'Invalid DOM property fetchpriority. Did you mean fetchPriority' — needs camelCase in JSX prop. Non-blocking.

Google Sign-In: 'GSI_LOGGER: The given origin is not allowed for the given client ID' — preview URL command-center-229.preview.emergentagent.com not whitelisted in Google Cloud Console. Expected — production leaderos.de is presumably whitelisted. Verify before switching to prod domain.

rca_of_the_issue: The 502s on /challengers are two orthogonal issues surfacing together: (a) sandberg persona voice_id 21m00Tcm4Tlm7axTlAzs no longer exists in ElevenLabs library → deterministic 404 → 502; (b) /challengers page fires 5 parallel TTS requests on mount but ElevenLabs plan caps concurrent at 3 → requests 4-5 return 429 concurrent_limit_exceeded → wrapped as 502. Both are outside the launch-critical path (chat, downloads, payments, auth all work) but produce visible 502s in browser network tab. Fix priority: LOW — cosmetic. Neither blocks the leaderos.de launch.
